profiles.name: Fictional dev-brief
profiles.style: Informal and conversational. Registry is casual, employing slang ('cuz'). Greetings are friendly ('hey'). Punctuation is minimal, reflecting spoken language. Writing habits include short, declarative sentences and frequent use of contractions. Emphasis on closeness and ease.

profiles.name: Fictional dev-formal
profiles.style: Formal and polite. Uses courteous greetings like "Good evening" and closings like "Kind regards." Frequent use of "thank you" conveys gratitude.  Simple sentence structure and proper punctuation (periods, commas).  Evokes a respectful, professional tone suggesting established rapport.

profiles.name: Fictional eval-punctuated
profiles.style: Friendly and informal. Greetings use exclamation points and expressions of pleasure. Register is casual, employing contractions and simple sentence structures. Frequent use of punctuation enhances emotional tone. Writing habits include short, declarative sentences and expressions of gratitude. Overall, exudes warmth and sociability.

profiles.name: Fictional eval-lowercase
profiles.style: Informal and conversational. Uses short, declarative sentences and contractions ('morning,' 'kettle,' 'yep'). Employs greetings and acknowledgements ('thanks,' 'all good'). Punctuation is minimal, relying on periods and question marks. Demonstrates a relaxed register suitable for brief exchanges. Writing habits include abrupt transitions and implied context.

profiles.name: Fictional eval-emoji
profiles.style: Conversational and friendly. Uses emoticons like smiling face and praying hands to convey emotion. Informal register with frequent use of 'Thanks' and expressions of appreciation. Short, declarative sentences prevail. Punctuation includes periods and ampersands. Writings exhibits positive and appreciative tendencies.

profiles.name: Fictional eval-detail
profiles.style: Formal and polite. Uses tentative language ('can', 'let us', 'will'). Frequent use of punctuation (periods, commas, semicolons). Employs phrases focusing on collaboration and confirmation. Avoids contractions; language is articulate and indirect. Generally avoids strong assertive statements.
